The house.

Saffron House BBQ grills authentic Persian kebab to order — free-range joojeh chicken marinated in saffron, prime koobideh beef seasoned the traditional way, and vine-ripened vegetables charred over the flame. Every tray is built fresh, not held under a lamp.
